regions.today: Showers this evening, heavy and prolonged at times with isolated thunderstorms, hail and localised flooding. Winds may be gusty in and around the showers.
regions.tonight: A mix of clear spells and isolated showers. Becoming breezy. Lowest temperatures of 10 to12 degrees, with moderate to fresh westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Monday will continue quite breezy but mostly dry apart from the odd isolated shower. Occasional sunny spells will develop, turning more hazy through the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in moderate to fresh west winds.
